description: This file implements the internal logic for rendering commit graphs in a version control system, including functions for managing graph layout, drawing commit lines, handling merge commits, and outputting commit messages with visual graph elements.

methods.name: graph_show_strbuf
methods.description: Outputs the contents of a strbuf line by line, optionally prefixing lines with graph output.

methods.name: graph_show_line_prefix
methods.description: Prints the line prefix for diff output if configured.

methods.name: graph_set_column_colors
methods.description: Sets the color palette used for graph columns.

methods.name: graph_get_current_column_color
methods.description: Returns the current default color index for columns, considering color preferences.

methods.name: graph_increment_column_color
methods.description: Advances the default column color index, wrapping around.

methods.name: graph_find_commit_color
methods.description: Finds the color assigned to a specific commit in the current graph layout.

methods.name: graph_find_new_column_by_commit
methods.description: Finds the index of a commit in the new_columns array.

methods.name: graph_insert_into_new_columns
methods.description: Inserts a commit into the new_columns array and updates the graph layout accordingly.

methods.name: graph_update_columns
methods.description: Updates the columns and layout for the current commit, handling merges and branch positioning.

methods.name: graph_update
methods.description: Updates the graph state with a new commit, preparing for rendering.

methods.name: graph_next_line
methods.description: Generates the next line of the graph output based on current state.

methods.name: graph_show_commit
methods.description: Outputs the commit and its associated graph lines.

methods.name: graph_show_oneline
methods.description: Outputs a single line representation of the commit with graph elements.

methods.name: graph_show_padding
methods.description: Outputs a padding line in the graph.

methods.name: graph_show_remainder
methods.description: Outputs remaining lines of the graph for the current commit.

methods.name: graph_show_commit_msg
methods.description: Outputs the commit message along with the graph visualization.
